content.text:
Header links and buttons now share one 44px control size, so **Application data** and **Sign out** match.

The mismatch came from styling `<button>` globally with `min-height` and padding, while `<a class="header-secondary-btn">` only got padding and inherited body line-height. Same pattern showed up on Apply on company site vs Re-render PDF, and it made the short **CV** tab look circular next to Cover letter.

What changed:

- Shared control tokens (`--control-height: 2.75rem` / 44px) in both token files, documented in `design.md`
- Chrome recipes (`header-secondary-btn`, primary, filter, dialog, tabs) now set the same box model on links and buttons
- Status chips use that height; the secondary job-action row is a 4-column grid
- Unstyled `.secondary-btn` / `.btn-ghost` alias the header recipe
- Cache-bust unified to `styles.css?v=91` on panel, company, apply, and admin

Measured at desktop and 375px: Application data / Sign out, job-action links vs buttons, CV / Cover letter, dialog Cancel / primary, and filter vs select are all **44px**. Avatar stays a 32px circle on purpose.

Reload the company workspace once so the new stylesheet isn’t cached.
